messages.subject: For Ian Cockerill | West Africa, stakeholder leadership and responsible growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Garman,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ian Cockerill, Chief Executive Officer.

Endeavour Mining's West African portfolio combines strong operating performance with a continued focus on organic growth and responsible mining. Across that footprint, government relationships, community confidence and disciplined stakeholder execution remain central to long-term value.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I manage complex external commitments through structured ownership, evidence, deadlines and escalation across multiple operating functions.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support Endeavour's country operations, government relations, social performance or strategic growth across West Africa. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
